existingCASecret.description: Existing CA Secret mounted in Core and network-control for PostgreSQL TLS.

publicURL.description: External console URL, including its console prefix. HTTPS is required except for canonical localhost, 127.0.0.0/8 or [::1] loopback addresses. This is separate from config.basePath, which is the API path. Core performs final URL validation.

deviceTTL.description: Device lifetime, 30s..10m; zero uses the Core default of 5m.

pollInterval.description: Polling interval, 1s..30s; zero uses the Core default of 5s.

accessTTL.description: Access lifetime, at least 1s and no greater than idleTTL; zero uses 15m.

idleTTL.description: Sliding idle lifetime, at least accessTTL and no greater than absoluteTTL; zero uses 168h.

absoluteTTL.description: Absolute lifetime, at least idleTTL and at most 8760h (365 days); zero uses 720h.

gatewayURL.description: Empty derives the model URL from the Core Service and config.basePath. Explicit URLs take precedence.

callbackURL.description: Empty derives the tools URL from the Core Service and config.basePath. Explicit URLs take precedence.
